duration: Teen Library Council meets Thursday afternoons
name: Teen Volunteer Service and Teen Library Council
what_you_do: Join teen service events during the school year and school breaks. The Teen Library Council meets regularly on Thursday afternoons.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students who are 18 or younger and either live in Skokie or attend a Skokie school.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Volunteer Service contact form to join the email list. Or email teenteam@skokielibrary.info. You can also come to an upcoming teen volunteer event.
notes: Some opportunities are only on school breaks or days off. If you need hours for a ticket or a court order, the page says to email the teen team with your name and school.
